memory.config.section: Memory automation (protected; no AI may change it): extraction.mode turns on candidates from accepted work (off, shadow records only, live writes candidates); automation narrows the Core bounds and WorkClass rows.
memory.withheld: {count} more entries are hidden: they come from work you may not read or a work target you may not use.
memory.alert.extractionBound: Memory extraction reached a bound in scope {scope}: {count} candidates were not written in this window (nothing was shortened).
memory.alert.screening: Memory extraction refused {count} candidates in scope {scope}: they held a secret or hidden characters.
error.MEMORY_ENTRY_WITHHELD: This memory entry comes from work you may not read; it is not shown.
error.MEMORY_PURGED_CONTENT: This content was purged from memory and cannot be proposed again.
error.MEMORY_EXTRACTION_BOUND: A memory extraction bound was reached; the candidate was not written.
error.MEMORY_CANDIDATE_SECRET: The memory candidate holds a secret and was refused.
error.MEMORY_CANDIDATE_QUARANTINED: The memory candidate holds hidden characters and was refused.
error.MEMORY_DISTILLER_REQUIRED: Only the memory distiller of this installation writes system candidates.
error.MEMORY_AUTOMATION_INVALID: The memory automation settings are invalid or try to widen a Core bound; only narrowing is allowed.
